title: What I Learned from my 10-Month Job Search
description:
You learn a lot about the job search process when you really don’t get anywhere for 10 months and then start working at a company whose purpose is helping people in their job search. I’d like to share some of my learnings today and hopefully something here can help in yours! #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobsearchhelp
